Company Overview

Exos Aerospace is an FAA-licensed reusable suborbital launch operator providing wet-lease flight-test infrastructure for space and defense applications. Exos delivers flight-proven reusable launch platforms that increase national test cadence, enable rapid iteration, and support payload recovery and operational learning.

Four core assets: (1) Scorpius Type‑5 cryogenic tank IP + ROFR (TRL‑9, lunar‑flown); (2) FAA‑licensed reusable suborbital platform (BLK3); (3) RDRE / advanced‑propulsion pipeline (USAF Phase II→III); (4) an AI‑deployed operating platform — Mission Control + a governed agent fleet running the business as a compounding, owned, ITAR/CUI‑safe asset.

Core Capabilities

  • Reusable suborbital launch vehicle operations
  • Wet-lease flight-test services for space and defense systems
  • NASA and DoD mission execution and contract performance
  • Type V linerless composite pressurized structures
  • Fractional parts-count architectures enabling repeatable reuse
  • LOX/methane propulsion integration and cryogenic Type V pressurized structures
Flight heritage. Onboard view of a suborbital mission above the atmosphere — four SARGE flights of demonstrated reusable operations.
Recovery & reuse. Guided-parafoil recovery returns the vehicle and payload intact for rapid turnaround.
Integrated & test-ready. BLK3 PSRLV vertical for integrated test — concept to powered hover in 12 months.

Operational Differentiators

Cadence-focused infrastructure. Operational flight platforms designed for repeatability rather than one-off launches, enabling faster campaign iteration and reduced program risk.

Wet-lease integration model. Exos operates and maintains the vehicle, reducing integration burden and accelerating timelines for government and commercial payload customers.

Integrated composite structures. Through its ownership position in Scorpius Space Launch Company, Exos strengthens industrial depth in Type V composite pressurized structures and scalable manufacturing capability.

RDRE-aligned flight-test capability. Exos is under contract with the U.S. Department of Defense to develop the flight vehicle for flight demonstration of a government-furnished LOX/methane Rotating Detonation Rocket Engine (RDRE), where repeatable operations, rapid turnaround, and practical test execution are critical.

Program Execution & Flight Heritage

  • Flew SARGE four times, demonstrating reusable suborbital launch operations and repeatable flight execution.
  • Developed BLK3 from concept to hover in 12 months under a USAF Phase II SBIR, validating integrated pressurized structures with a 25% size increase and 29% weight reduction.
  • NASA contract performance and suborbital research mission support.
  • Northrop Grumman Lunar Lander Challenge — 1st place (Round 1), 2nd place (Round 2).
  • Pioneering work in supersonic suborbital launch vehicles and modular vehicle architectures.
  • Propulsion heritage spanning hundreds of engines (including LOX/methane) and more than a dozen flying vehicles, with hundreds of successful in-flight relights.
